title: fpqc-locality criterion for properties of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks
statement_scope: Whole Proposition 1.5.23: let P be a property of nonconnective spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks. Then P is local for the fpqc topology if and only if the following conditions are satisfied: (1) P is local for the étale topology (the author text prints Definition 1.5.22 here); (2) if f: A → B is a flat morphism of E∞-rings such that Spec A has P, then Spec B has P, and the converse holds provided that f is faithfully flat.
standard_prerequisites: Definition 1.5.2 of locality for the étale topology (author PDF p. 23).
Definition 1.5.20 of a flat covering (author PDF pp. 27-28).
Example 1.5.21: every étale surjection is a flat covering (author PDF p. 28).
Definition 1.5.22 of locality for the fpqc topology (author PDF p. 28).
Étale-local reduction of properties of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks and faithful flatness.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because the proof at author PDF p. 28 is a concrete two-direction locality argument: it verifies fpqc condition (i) by reducing an arbitrary flat morphism X → Y to the affine étale case, factoring X → Spec A → Y with Spec A → Y étale and B flat over A, and applying condition (2); it verifies condition (ii) by reducing Y to an affine quasi-compact stack, choosing an étale surjection Spec B → X, using condition (1) and faithful flatness of B over A to apply condition (2). This is non-routine local descent material, but a supporting criterion rather than an H3 construction.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Étale-local affine reduction for fpqc condition (i), and affine plus étale-surjection reduction with faithful flatness for condition (ii).
